title: OHLGT-L03 (loan 12) repayment four-bucket allocation with ALL FOUR buckets non-zero and fee != penalty
_note: Parity vector transcribing the four-bucket allocation of OHLGT-L03 (loan 12) repayment transaction 53. This is the ALLOCATION counterpart of F-2026-09-09: LN-L03, the only other allocation vector, carries fee=0 and penalty=0, so a port that drops the fee bucket, the penalty bucket, or both passes it. Here all four request buckets are non-zero and fee (10000) differs from penalty (5700), so the two omissions are discriminated separately. request.repayment.outstanding = {penalty 5700, fee 10000, interest 661853, principal 10000000} is the loan's pre-repayment outstanding derived from the committed before-state read-back (loan-12-before-raw.json: penaltyChargesOutstanding 57.0, feeChargesOutstanding 100.0, interestOutstanding 6618.53, principalOutstanding 100000.0) in integer minor units. request.repayment.amount_minor=9797865 is repayment 53's amount 97978.65. expect.allocation = {penalty 5700, fee 10000, interest 661853, principal 9120312} is transaction 53's penaltyChargesPortion 57.0, feeChargesPortion 100.0, interestPortion 6618.53 and principalPortion 91203.12; expect.leftover_minor=0 is the fully-consumed payment. The four portions SUMMED equal the amount paid exactly (5700+10000+661853+9120312=9797865), the splits-sum-to-the-whole invariant. The transaction's loanChargePaidByList names both real charges (OHLGT-Fee-SDD-100 100.0 and OHLGT-Penalty-SDD-57 57.0) because the loan-level pool is fully consumed, the observed allocation is exactly the greedy four-bucket order penalty, fee, interest, principal of that pool. Nothing was computed by this promotion; every cell is a transcription of the oracle's read-back.

provenance.note: expect.allocation and expect.leftover_minor are transcribed from transaction 53 of the committed capture loan-12-transactions-after-raw.json (externalId OHLGT-L03 appears in the same file); request.repayment.outstanding is transcribed from the committed before-state read-back loan-12-before-raw.json, both under .softhouse/capture/loan12-four-bucket-allocation/. capture_case_id names the externalId of the observed loan. The request body that drove the repayment (req/repay-OHALLOCG-97978.65.json) is committed byte-stable: transactionAmount and transactionDate are JSON strings, so the body carries NO numeric JSON token and survives a binary-double round trip trivially.
